description: This file defines the OA_Auth class responsible for user authentication, login, logout, session management, and related security functions within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Auth
classes.description: Class handling user authentication, session management, login/logout processes, and security warnings within the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: staticGetAuthPlugin
methods.description: Returns the authentication plugin instance based on configuration, with fallback to internal plugin.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login process, including credential verification, session regeneration, and redirection.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user via the authentication plugin.

methods.name: suppliedCredentials
methods.description: Checks if login credentials were provided via POST parameters.

methods.name: checkAndQueueUnsafePasswordWarning
methods.description: Queues a warning message if the current user's password is marked as unsafe.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Authenticates the user using the authentication plugin and logs login time.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently logged in.

methods.name: getSessionData
methods.description: Returns session data array for a given user object.

methods.name: getFakeSessionData
methods.description: Returns a placeholder session data array indicating no user.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the login process, optionally displaying a message.

methods.name: displayError
methods.description: Displays an error message and restarts login.

methods.name: displayLogin
methods.description: Displays the login screen, optionally with a message.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Checks if the application is running in the correct directory and redirects if necessary.

methods.name: sendResetEmailAndDisplayMessage
methods.description: Sends password reset email and displays reset message for a user.
